rules.title: Unsupported Search & Navigation (Find) Packages
rules.message: Project references unsupported package '{package}'. Search & Navigation is not supported in CMS 13.
rules.fix: Remove the package and install 'Optimizely.Graph.Cms.Query' and 'Optimizely.Graph.AspNetCore'.

rules.title: Obsolete FilterAccess Query Methods
rules.message: Direct call to '{match}' detected. Distinct access query methods are deprecated in CMS 13.
rules.fix: Replace direct FilterAccess calls with IContentAccessEvaluator.HasAccess().

rules.title: Compiler Warnings As Errors Not Enabled
rules.message: <TreatWarningsAsErrors> is not set to true in this project file or in an imported Directory.Build.props. Obsolete CMS 12 APIs are easy to miss.
rules.fix: Enable <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> before updating CMS packages to surface all deprecations early.

rules.title: Site Definition Usage (Application Model Review)
rules.message: '{match}' is used ({count} occurrence(s) in this file). Site definitions are affected by the CMS 13 Application model; review this file (multi-site host mapping, custom repositories) against the new model. (unverified: syntax-only match)
rules.fix: Review the CMS 13 Application model documentation and migrate site-definition lookups and custom repositories accordingly.

rules.title: Target Framework Not Ready For .NET 10
rules.message: Project targets '{framework}', which does not include .NET 10 or later.
rules.fix: Plan the framework upgrade to .NET 10 as part of the CMS 13 upgrade (the Upgrade Assistant can help with the framework change).
